info.name: Mobile APIs
info.description: Citizen-facing APIs for the mobile application. Protected requests use {{citizen_token}}. Every request uses Accept-Language: {{accept_language}}; set ar to test localized complaint display names and classification with Arabic text such as انقطاع الكهرباء.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Mobile citizen authentication flow. Copy OTPs from Mailtrap/email into citizen_otp.

request.description:
Purpose: Start citizen login and send OTP by email.
Required role: public
Required token: none
Expected response: standard GCMS API envelope with success, message, data, and meta when present.

exec: pm.test('status code is 200 or 201', function () { pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('response has success key', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('success'); });
var json = pm.response.json();
function getPath(obj, path) { return path.split('.').reduce(function (current, key) { return current && current[key] !== undefined ? current[key] : undefined; }, obj); }

[["data.user_id","data.user.id"]].flat().some(function (path) { var value = getPath(json, path); if (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '') { pm.environment.set('citizen_user_id', value); return true; } return false; });

item.name: Citizen Complaints
item.description: Citizen complaint creation and viewing routes.

Purpose: List complaints owned by the authenticated citizen. Optional sort values are newest (default), oldest, and sla; sla puts complaints with a due_at deadline first, ordered by the earliest deadline.
Required role: citizen
Required token: {{citizen_token}}
Expected response: standard GCMS API envelope with success, message, data, and meta when present.

exec: pm.test('status code is 200 or 201', function () { pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('response has success key', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('success'); });

request.description:
Purpose: Create a complaint with JSON body. Saves complaint_id and complaint_number when returned. Both the existing flat location fields (latitude, longitude, address) and the additive nested location object (location.lat, location.lng, location.address) are accepted; flat fields take precedence when both are sent. client_ref is accepted as an alias for client_uuid. Localization example: compare accept_language=en and ar; user-entered title/description and canonical status remain unchanged while system message and lookup display names localize.
Required role: citizen
Required token: {{citizen_token}}
Expected response: standard GCMS API envelope with success, message, data, and meta when present.

body.raw:
{
    "title": "Street light is broken",
    "description": "The street light near my house has been broken for three days.",
    "department_id": "{{department_id}}",
    "category_id": "{{category_id}}",
    "priority_id": "{{priority_id}}",
    "latitude": 33.5138,
    "longitude": 36.2765,
    "address": "Damascus",
    "source": "mobile"
}

exec: pm.test('status code is 200 or 201', function () { pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('response has success key', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('success'); });
var json = pm.response.json();
function getPath(obj, path) { return path.split('.').reduce(function (current, key) { return current && current[key] !== undefined ? current[key] : undefined; }, obj); }

[["data.id","data.complaint.id"]].flat().some(function (path) { var value = getPath(json, path); if (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '') { pm.environment.set('complaint_id', value); return true; } return false; });

[["data.complaint_number","data.complaint.complaint_number"]].flat().some(function (path) { var value = getPath(json, path); if (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '') { pm.environment.set('complaint_number', value); return true; } return false; });

request.description:
Purpose: Warn a citizen about nearby active complaints in the same category before creating one. This is read-only and warning-only: it does not create, block, or modify complaints. Default radius: 15 meters.
Required role: citizen
Required token: {{citizen_token}}
Expected response: standard GCMS API envelope with has_possible_duplicate and a privacy-limited nearest-first matches list.

exec: pm.test('status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('response has duplicate-check data', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('has_possible_duplicate'); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('matches'); });

request.description:
Purpose: Submit exactly one text response to the current employee information request. The complaint remains waiting_citizen. Attachments remain separate: this request may be run before or after Add Attachment, and multiple attachment uploads remain supported. A second text response returns 422; using another citizen token returns 403.
Required role: citizen
Required token: {{citizen_token}}
Expected response: standard GCMS API envelope with the existing complaint shape.

exec: pm.test('status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('complaint remains waiting for employee review', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data.status).to.eql('waiting_citizen'); });

item.name: Offline Sync
item.description: Offline sync routes. Mobile clients generate client_uuid and can retry safely; sending the same client_uuid should not create a duplicate complaint. The existing flat payload remains supported. Additively, complaint data may be sent inside complaint with complaint.location.lat, complaint.location.lng, complaint.location.address, and complaint.client_ref as a client_uuid alias; top-level fields take precedence.

request.description:
Purpose: Sync one offline complaint. Saves offline_submission_id and complaint details.
Required role: citizen
Required token: {{citizen_token}}
Expected response: standard GCMS API envelope with success, message, data, and meta when present.
client_uuid is generated by the mobile app and used for idempotency.

body.raw:
{
    "client_uuid": "{{offline_client_uuid}}",
    "title": "Offline complaint from mobile",
    "description": "This complaint was created while the user was offline.",
    "department_id": "{{department_id}}",
    "category_id": "{{category_id}}",
    "priority_id": "{{priority_id}}",
    "latitude": 33.5138,
    "longitude": 36.2765,
    "address": "Damascus",
    "created_offline_at": "2026-07-05T10:00:00Z",
    "source": "offline_sync"
}

exec: pm.test('status code is 200 or 201', function () { pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: Devices and Preferences
item.description: Device token and notification preference routes. The unchanged token payload accepts both Expo tokens from Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync() and existing native FCM tokens; the backend detects the provider automatically. Postman uses fake_fcm_token only for backend testing.

request.description:
Purpose: Register or update a device token. Submit the existing token/platform payload unchanged: Expo tokens such as ExponentPushToken[...] and ExpoPushToken[...] are automatically delivered through Expo, while other tokens continue through FCM.
Required role: citizen
Required token: {{citizen_token}}
Expected response: standard GCMS API envelope with success, message, data, and meta when present.
Saves device_token_id when returned.

item.name: Classification Preview
item.description: Rule-based complaint classification preview before submit.

request.description:
Purpose: Preview predicted department/category without creating a complaint. Localization example: use Arabic text (انقطاع الكهرباء) under either accept_language value; IDs/codes/method stay canonical and only display names/messages localize.
Required role: citizen
Required token: {{citizen_token}}
Expected response: standard GCMS API envelope with success, message, data, and meta when present.

exec: pm.test('status code is 200 or 201', function () { pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('response has success key', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('success'); });
pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'Accept-Language', value: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{accept_language}}') || 'en' });

variable.description: Human-readable response language. Set to ar to exercise Arabic complaint and classification examples.
